nodes.label: Single PostgreSQL Database
nodes.rationale: Use one PostgreSQL database for jobs, metadata, and checkpoints until real scale requires split storage.

nodes.label: Polling Job Status
nodes.rationale: Polling keeps the MVP simpler than websockets for long-running generation jobs.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Checkpointing
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL checkpointing keeps pipeline state durable without adding another service.

nodes.label: Mocked External Services
nodes.rationale: Routine tests mock external providers so verification is deterministic.

nodes.label: Sequential Python Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Private MVP replaces the larger LangGraph design with one sequential pipeline until branches and resume behavior matter.

nodes.label: Native MP4 Video
nodes.rationale: MP4 plus native video and WebVTT cover the private MVP before HLS and video.js are needed.
